WEI_PER_PLANCK().notice: pallet-revive maps 1 native planck to 10^4 wei (nativeToEthRatio).

approveMilestone(uint256,uint256).notice: Approve the submitted evidence. The approval that reaches quorum releases the tranche in the same transaction when the activity metric (if any) is already met.

reclaim(uint256,uint256).notice: After the deadline, an unreleased tranche returns to the funder.

release(uint256,uint256).notice: Anyone may trigger payout once quorum is reached; reverts while the activity metric is below target, so the tranche stays in escrow until it is met.

requestChanges(uint256,uint256,string).notice: Any reviewer can send a submission back; approvals from that round no longer count.

userdoc.notice: Vestry: milestone grants whose tranches leave escrow only after reviewer quorum and, optionally, an on-chain activity metric read directly from the grantee's own contract. Native POT tranches land as native vesting locks on the grantee. Portaldot charges a storage deposit per byte and per item, so state is packed into as few slots as possible and delivery evidence lives in events, not storage.
